title: Good Friends and Families
text:
Good friends help each other when they have problems. They spend time together and talk about their days. Good friends also listen when someone is sad. Many people say that a good friend is very important in life.

Families are also important relationships. Parents often take care of their children. Brothers and sisters can be best friends, but they can also argue. In most families, love and respect help people stay together.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do good friends do when someone is sad?
According to paragraph two, what do parents often do?
options: They take care of their children

questions.text: What can we infer about a person who has a good friend?
options: They probably have no free time

questions.text: What can we infer about families from the passage?
options: Families are less important than friends
Love and respect can help them stay together

vocabulary.definition: people you know well and like spending time with
the way people are connected to each other
a feeling of admiration for someone's good qualities
to disagree with someone in a loud or serious way

paragraph_translations: İyi arkadaşlar sorunları olduğunda birbirlerine yardım eder. Birlikte zaman geçirir ve günleri hakkında konuşurlar. İyi arkadaşlar, biri üzgün olduğunda da dinler. Pek çok insan, iyi bir arkadaşın hayatta çok önemli olduğunu söyler.

Aileler de önemli ilişkilerdir. Ebeveynler genellikle çocuklarına bakar. Kardeşler en iyi arkadaş olabilir, ama tartışabilirler de. Çoğu ailede sevgi ve saygı, insanların birlikte kalmasına yardımcı olur.
